features: Code-split Nutrition Intelligence overview, accessible as first nutrition subtab; lazy loaded exclusively when it is selected
Rolling 7/14/42/90-day windows with previous/next paging across calendar weeks
Source-aware kcal, protein, salt, fibre, saturated fat and selected vitamin/mineral daily averages, and selectable historical bar chart
Product frequency, sum of recorded quantities without inventing absent gram conversions, macro-nutrient contributions
Daily Dozen documented servings and target reach per category over time, plus evidence-based Anti-Aging Eight observable categories (not a longevity score)

Explicit on-demand local recommendation engine: named ranked salt sources with grams and share of quantified sum, Daily Dozen gaps and catalog-based food suggestions; protein and ALA only where quantification supports
On-demand results invalidated by changes to log, catalog or date period; no vault mutations, automatic habits or internet requests
Preserves all previous journal tabs, food entries, IDs, deadlines and Mensa integration. Does not add Nutrition module to Today startup.
scopeLimits: This is the first nutrition-coaching stage. Sleep, worktime, contacts, habits and training-time causal analyses are not implemented in this release.
The 42-day option is a rolling window; not yet the start/end dates of a specific strength training block.
Anti-Aging Eight entries requiring biomarkers (NAD+, microRNA) are not measurable from food logging.
Recorded food and nutrient contributions are not proof of dietary completeness or clinical deficiency.
preservation: No catalog or journal entries/food IDs changed; UI and read-only analysis only.
viteBuildReason: Vite not installed locally; GitHub Actions must verify actual production build.
